meta.title: Technical Stage screen updates as vendors place bids

plan.title: Technical Stage updates after vendor bid

steps.note: Open a suitable existing published event with a Technical Stage.
Open the Technical Stage before any new vendor bid.
Verify that no technical-stage vendor submissions are shown initially.
Have an invited vendor submit a bid, including its technical response for the two-stage event.
Confirm that the vendor submission was accepted.
Reopen the Technical Stage to force the post-bid view to refresh.
Verify that the vendor's submission now appears on the Technical Stage response view.
